What it can build

Six specialists. One brain.

Every capability below runs on the same Aviqo core — no separate logins, no exporting between apps, no context lost between tasks.

01 / IMAGE

Image Generation

From concept art to product mockups and social creatives — describe it once, get gallery-ready visuals in seconds.

 02 / VIDEO

Video Generation

Turn a script or a single prompt into edited, scene-aware video — ads, explainers, and reels included.

 03 / WEB

Website Building

Describe your business, get a fully designed, responsive website — copy, layout, and motion included.

 04 / APP

App Building

Ship functional web and mobile apps from a plain-language brief — Aviqo handles logic, design, and deployment.

 05 / STUDY

Study & Research

Summaries, explanations, exam prep and structured notes tuned to how you actually learn — any subject, any level.

 06 / ASSIST

Personal AI Assistant

Plans your day, drafts your messages, tracks your tasks, and remembers context — a second brain that's always on.

About Aviqo AI

One team, one belief — AI should feel like one tool, not ten.

Aviqo AI started with a simple frustration: creating anything online meant juggling a different app for every step — one tool for images, another for video, another for the website, another just to keep track of tasks. We built Aviqo to collapse all of that into a single place.

Our Mission

To give every individual and small business the power of a full creative and technical team — inside one AI, available anytime.

Read our mission →

Our Vision

A future where you describe an outcome in plain language, and one trusted AI carries it from idea to finished product.

Read our vision →

Where We Started

Aviqo AI is built and run out of Punjab, India — a small, focused team designing for creators and businesses everywhere.

Read our story →
More about us →
